title: Adversarial finding
description: One finding from the three-altitude review procedure (GOV-018, ARCH-006 stage 5). The one record format the gate queue (phase-irs-13) and the learning loop (phase-irs-10) read. Findings are stored inside a review record, one JSON file per review under docs/08-governance/reviews/; that file's shape is definitions/review below. The adversary writes every field except dispositions; dispositions are written by the planner at stage 4 and by the owner at G3.

id.description: The finding's id, unique within its review record: F01, F02 and so on.

altitude.description: plan=the plan as a whole, against its requirement | phase=one phase in isolation | later-added-phase=a phase registered after the plan, read against the standing plan (GOV-018).

subject.description: What the finding is about: the plan's document code at the plan altitude, a backlog phase id at the other two.

severity.description: blocker=the plan cannot go to G3 approval with this unresolved; an unresolved blocker escalates to G3 (ARCH-006 stage 5) | major=the plan works but a phase will fail or be redone without a change | minor=a defect worth fixing that does not change what gets built.

evidence.description: What the adversary checked to establish the defect: the command and its output, or the file and line quoted. A suspicion that was not checked is not a finding.

consequence.description: What goes wrong if the defect stands, stated concretely.

minimal_fix.description: The smallest change that would resolve the finding, named rather than written. Optional; the adversary never authors the fix into the plan (GOV-014).

engine.description: The adversarial engine that produced the finding. single-adversary is the only engine until the expander/minimalist/arbiter trio ships (phase-agx-11, phase-agx-12); the trio's value and its argument and ruling fields are added then, as optional properties, so records written now stay valid.

author.description: Who produced the finding: the agent type and the prompt it was dispatched with, for example 'partition-adversary dispatched with PROMPT-038'.

slug.description: Recurrence key, optional. A short kebab-case name the adversary proposes for the anti-pattern the finding is an instance of. Whoever records it in the anti-pattern store (phase-irs-10) confirms or changes it. The store matches on an exact slug plus a list of aliases per entry (batch-005 Q1, option 2).

aliases.description: Other slugs the adversary believes name the same anti-pattern. Optional; allowed only with a slug.

dispositions.description: What was decided about the finding, oldest first; the last entry is the current disposition. The planner writes one at stage 4. A finding the planner escalates gets a second entry, written by the owner at G3. Absent until the planner acts; a review whose status is dispositioned requires it on every finding.

value.description: fixed=the plan was changed; reason says where | accepted-no-change=the finding is correct and the plan stays as it is; reason says why | rejected=the finding is wrong; reason says why | escalated-g3=the planner cannot resolve it and the owner decides at G3.

by.description: The role that wrote this disposition: the planner at stage 4, the owner at G3.

recorded_by.description: Who filled the role, for example an agent id or repository-owner.

reason.description: Where the fix is, why the finding is accepted without change or rejected, or why it is escalated.

review.title: Review record
review.description: One file under docs/08-governance/reviews/, named <review_id>.json. Holds one run of the procedure against one plan: the entry check's result and the findings from all three altitudes.

review_id.description: The file's name without .json: the review date, then the target in kebab case.

plan.description: The plan reviewed: its document code, or for a draft with no code yet, its path.

requirement.description: The requirement document paired with the plan, if there is one.

phases.description: The phases reviewed at the phase altitude.

later_added_phases.description: The phases reviewed at the later-added-phase altitude.

result.description: pass=the draft conforms to the standard's mechanical check | returned=it does not, and it went back to the planner with no adversary dispatched | exempt=the standard does not apply, because the plan was written before 2026-09-22 (GOV-010, Scope).

missing_sections.description: The GOV-010 sections the draft lacks. Required when the result is returned.

detail.description: The command run and its result, or the reason the plan is exempt.

altitudes_run.description: The altitudes the adversary was dispatched for. Empty only when the entry check returned the draft. A skipped altitude is visible here rather than implied by an absence of findings.

status.description: returned=stopped at the entry check | open=findings recorded, dispositions not yet complete | dispositioned=every finding carries at least one disposition; this is the state the review hands to phase-fit (ARCH-006, Review -> phase-fit).

findings.description: Every finding from every altitude run. Never silently dropped: a finding the planner disagrees with is dispositioned rejected, not removed.

notes.description: Anything a reader needs about how this review was run. Optional.
